name: Ham
description: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

note.label: As in the Days of Noah: Past & Present

points: “And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.” So Lamech begat Noah.

note.label: Good And Evil | Generation To Generation: From Beginning To End

points: Shem, Ham, and Japheth went forth out of the ark and the whole earth was overspread from them. Ham dwelt in what is called Africa; Shem in the land mass toward Arabia; Japheth went into Europe.

Ham is the father of Canaan, and Canaan dwelt in the land later called the land of Israel. That is how you know the land of Israel is a part of Africa; the maps separate Israel from Africa so that the connection is not made.

note.label: Genesis 9: The Laws Before Moses and the Covenant of the Bow

points: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: so the generations of the sons of Noah.

note.label: All Nations Return To Their Land & Jerusalem Exalted

points: “The generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth”: yes, the sons of these generations become nations. They gave birth to multiples of nations. Shem gave birth to the Assyrians, Syrians, Elamites, Moabites, Ammonites and Israelites. Japheth gave birth to the Javanites: Germany, Greece, Rome, the Etruscans, the Minoans. Ham is explanatory: Hamites, Ethiopians, Egyptians, Canaanites, Libyans, Somalians.

note.label: Escape New Years | Armageddon: Chain Of Events

points: Who are the sons of Ham? When you get a Bible dictionary it says Ham became the father of all the dark races, but not the Negroes.

note.label: The Truth Behind Christmas and New Years

points: The sons of Ham: Cush is Ethiopia; Mizraim is Egypt; Phut is Libya, to the left of Egypt; and Canaan is the land where Jerusalem sits.
Ham inhabited what is known as Africa, and Canaan's land is the land of Israel; so the land of Israel is part of Africa.

note.label: Genesis 10: Shem, Ham, Japheth, and Nimrod

points: “And the sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, and Phut, and Canaan.” Ham was the youngest son of Noah and one of the eight persons who lived through the flood. He became the progenitor of the dark races, but he is not the father of the Negroes: the Egyptians, Ethiopians, Libyans (not the modern ones you see today) and the Canaanites. The sons of Ham are the Hamites, the Nilotes. The Ishmaelites, the people of Ishmael, are the Arabs, a totally different race of people. The Arabs are not the ancient Egyptians nor Libyans, and the Caucasians are not the Jews, the children of Israel.

note.label: The Purpose of God's Wrath and Mercy

points: “And the sons of Ham; Cush”: that’s Ethiopia. “And Mizraim”: write that down, Mizraim is Egypt. “And Phut”: north Africa.

note.label: | SABBATH EVENING CLASS: The Third Kingdom of Babylon

points: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries: so the Lord had the Canaanites divided in particular areas, the Hamitic tribes. The Lord gave them a land mass, and he separated them by tribes.

note.label: All Nations Return To Their Land & Jerusalem Exalted

points: “These are the sons of Ham, after their families, after their tongues, in their countries, and in their nations.” It starts with the sons of Ham, and we end it right there regarding the sons of Ham, because we mentioned earlier the giants in the days of old.

note.label: Good And Evil | Generation To Generation: From Beginning To End

points: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: so from Methuselah and Lamech came Noah. From Noah came who? Shem, Ham and Japheth. So those were the sons of Noah.
The line from the first man is set down in order: Adam, Seth, Enos, Cainan, Mahalaleel, Jered, Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, Noah, and the three sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 1: The Generations from Adam to Edom

points: The sons of Ham: now the sons of Ham. Remember Noah had three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth. So now we're reading about the sons of Ham. So the lineage of Ham. Let's see what we find.
The sons of Ham are named: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan, and the sons that came from them.

note.label: 1 Chronicles 1: The Generations from Adam to Edom
